'''264''' ('''two hundred [and] sixty-four''') is the [[natural number]] following [[263 (number)|263]] and preceding [[265 (number)|265]].

==In mathematics==
264 is:
* an even [[composite number]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://mathworld.wolfram.com/|title=Composite Number|first=Eric W.|last=Weisstein|website=mathworld.wolfram.com}}</ref>
* a [[Rencontres numbers|Recontres number]] with one fixed point.<ref>{{Cite web |title=A000240 - OEIS |url=https://oeis.org/A000240 |access-date=2026-06-23 |website=oeis.org}}</ref>
* the number of closed [[Self-avoiding walk|self-avoiding walks]] from the origin in [[4]] steps.<ref>{{Cite web |title=A001337 - OEIS |url=https://oeis.org/A001337 |access-date=2026-06-23 |website=oeis.org}}</ref>
* the largest known number whose square is undulating: <math>264^2 = 69696</math><ref>{{Cite web |title=Number Gossip: 264 |url=https://numbergossip.com/264 |access-date=2026-09-02 |website=numbergossip.com}}</ref>
